meta.label: Patch 26.23
meta.caveat: PBE content can change before release.
notes: Live is patch 26.22. This page lists what patch 26.23 changes.

Update 2026-11-06: patch 26.22 is live, so its changes left this page. Patch 26.23 adds four augments (Slime Time, Fortified, Mystic Guard and Steadfast Presence), makes Group Hug reach farther, raises Vel'Koz's R damage and changes turret plating in Mayhem.

Update 2026-11-06 (patch 26.23): Pat On The Back, Shark Tempest and Surge Field leave the augment pool. Salvation recharges faster (90 → 70 seconds) and No Mana, No Problem turns Mana into more Ability Power.

Update 2026-11-09 (patch 26.23): Steadfast Presence is renamed Steadfaster Presence, Bouncing Bees' bounce damage becomes a flat 60% at every level (was 50–100% by level), and Perplexity adds 500% base Mana Regen.

Update 2026-11-10 (patch 26.23): a batch of champion changes (Annie's Tibbers, Azir, Bard, Ezreal, Galio, Gnar, K'Sante and Mel stronger; Master Yi's Q weaker; Vi's E stronger), FireFox deals more damage, The Boom and the Bass deals less, and Voltaic Cyclosword's Energized attack deals a bit less.
Ability values are listed for ranks 1-5 (basic abilities) or 1-3 (ultimates).

fame.summary: No new Fame bands on the test server yet.

superstarRank.summary: Fame also raises your Superstar Rank (10 milestones on its own track) and unlocks bands plus Audition Missions, which must be completed within a single game.

added.name: Slime Time
added.description: Every 6 seconds, automatically release a burst of slime that deals 40–80 (by level) plus 3–8% max Health magic damage to nearby enemies. Hitting a champion leaves a slime blob: walk over it to heal 6–15% (by level). Enemies can destroy the blob.

added.name: Fortified
added.description: Gain 20 Armor, then increase your bonus Armor by 25%.

added.name: Mystic Guard
added.description: Gain 20 Magic Resist, then increase your bonus Magic Resist by 25%.

added.name: Steadfaster Presence
added.description: Gain 16% bonus Armor and Magic Resist and 20% Tenacity. Below 40% max Health, this rises to 32% bonus Armor and Magic Resist and 40% Tenacity.

changes.stat: Bounce damage (% of the original attack)

headliners.summary: New on the test server. Each Mayhem match has one Headliner that adds game-wide bonuses.

list.name: Bit Rush
list.effect: Takedowns earn Tokens. While dead, spend 4 Tokens to revive at your fountain with 125% bonus Move Speed that fades over 10 seconds.

list.name: Debonair Zed
list.effect: Every augment you pick also gives gold (200, 350, 500 or 750), and some also give a hat.

list.name: La Ilusión
list.effect: Allies drop a candle when they die. Picking it up within 10 seconds shields you and allies within 1500 range for 4 seconds: 250 + 35% max Health (smaller candles: 150 + 15%).

list.name: Maestro Jhin
list.effect: Augment offers show 4 choices instead of 3.

championChanges.summary: Base-game champion changes on the test server. They also apply in Mayhem.

changes: Tibbers Health from Annie's bonus Health 0% → 150%
Q AP ratio per extra bolt 8% → 9%

itemChanges.summary: Changes to items in the Mayhem shop. Runes are unchanged.

modeChanges: Turret plating gets its own Mayhem values: 3 plates per turret worth 100 gold each (normally 5 worth 120), and a turret's defensive Armor and Magic Resist bonus is 60 (normally 30), plus 5 for each extra champion.
